validatedCapabilities.detail: Club → Teams workspace is active with stable team IDs and isolated team data.
12U Boys and 14U Boys have coexisted in the same club workspace with cross-team isolation confirmed.
Following is read-only and remains separate from permanent membership/authority; followed-team results and archives use viewing-team context.
Concurrent games and multiple scorer handoffs were observed in pilot evidence while scorer authority remains game-scoped.
Per-team GroupMe routes were tested for both active pilot teams with delivery isolation preserved.
Final games load structured recaps/stats and Tournaments & Weekends remain team-aware.
Multi-game event/weekend evidence has been observed in the club pilot validation record.
Unlisted opponent names are preserved raw and can be explicitly mapped by an Owner without automatic identity guessing.
Launch readiness, team/season context, access shortcuts and duplicate-game preflight are in the production baseline.
Lamorinda scoring uses the club-branded blue/gold game experience without changing scoring layout or protected scoring behavior.

deferred.detail: Underlying local recovery remains protected, but a real-device offline/reconnect proving run is intentionally deferred because target venues generally have adequate connectivity.

externalDependencies.detail: Validate official schedule → Game-Day Hub → manual fallback reconciliation when a real current-season official schedule is published. Do not fabricate source data.

releaseRule: 7.59.0 marks the manual-game Lamorinda club pilot ready; official-feed validation is tracked separately when external source data exists.
